messages:
anya: quick note - while onboarding llama3-mini-int8 on h100 in three regions we saw p95 spikes in us-west after a routing tweak. p50 remained fine. curious if warmup fragility is the culprit. sharing short logs and numbers below.
josiah: saw that too, flagging the routing flip at 03:12 UTC. it changed edge preference to nearby-pop-first then balanced.
maria: timeline pls - did capacity or kernel switch happen around same time?
anya: timeline — 03:11: routing policy changed (edge weight adjust), 03:12: quick canary push of int8 kernel v2 (low-level micro-optimizations), 03:13: surge of p95 in us-west. us-east/eu-west stable.
linda: kernel v2 is mostly cache layout tweaks, shouldn't change latency distribution much. but int8 warmup pattern does: prefix KV misses for first few requests cause long tails.
anya: numbers snapshot 03:10->03:20:
- us-west H100 p50 32ms -> 34ms, p95 120ms -> 380ms
- us-east H100 p50 30ms -> 31ms, p95 110ms -> 115ms
- eu-west H100 p50 35ms -> 37ms, p95 125ms -> 130ms
throughput steady ~220 rps per node.
josiah: interesting that only us-west tail blew up. did warmup traffic pattern differ?
maria: deploy-bot logs: "route-change: prefer-local-edge=true" at 03:11, "canary-kernel-v2" at 03:12. no autoscale events.
linda: hypothesis: edge routing caused a new proxy path with an extra hop that delayed initial kv-cache population for int8 model shards. p50 unaffected because warmed sessions but p95 hit cold sessions.
anya: repro plan: 1) force traffic to us-west with slow-cold prefixes to trigger cold-KV paths, 2) compare kernel v1 vs v2 on H100 and A100, 3) try forcing balanced routing to see tail recovery.
josiah: i can flip a canary to balanced routing for 10m. want me to run as soon as we have repro traffic? :thumbsup:
maria: also capture per-request hop_count and kv_cache_hit boolean in traces. add small eval set (1000 short+long prompts).
anya: putting a quick curl harness here:
```
for i in {1..1000}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"short prompt"}' https://api.redwood/v1/generate; sleep 0.02; done
```
run one warmup with varied prefixes.
linda: note on kernels: v1 used fused-attn-quant path that keeps single-hop proxy path cheap; v2 moved to chunked matmul to avoid memory spikes. chunking can add slight latency when KV cold.
anya: ok action items: josiah flip routing to balanced for 10m (will call it now), maria add hop_count+kv flag to traces, linda prepare A100 vs H100 kernel comparison job, i'll run the harness and post results.
josiah: flipping to balanced now. revert in 15m if stable.
maria: tracing flag added, starting capturing from now.
linda: queued kernel A100/H100 matrix - will post p50/p95 table in this thread.
anya: initial quick run (5m into balanced): us-west p95 dropped from 380ms -> 128ms. seems routing change is main contributor. will run full matrix next. :relieved:
josiah: nice. keep an eye for any regressions on eu-west.
anya: will do, logging results here when complete. thanks team.
